items.title: Lennar (LEN) Opens New Home Communities In Madison And Valencia
items.summary: Lennar (NYSE:LEN) announced grand openings for new single family home communities in Madison, Alabama, and Valencia, California. The Madison community, Hitching Post Farms, targets buyers seeking modern amenities and access to local schools and outdoor attractions. The Valencia communities, Sutton and Hollis, focus on higher access locations for commuters along with nearby services and recreation.
